clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in the jungle at Nesingwary's Expedition, Ajeck Rouack raises the stakes of his hunting trials. He demands the death of ten elder Stranglethorn tigers to prove your prowess before the final test.

Following the earlier hunts, Ajeck Rouack asks you to pursue ten elder Stranglethorn tigers across the wilds. He considers these beasts both the most elusive to track and the fiercest to overcome. Felling ten of them serves as the prelude to a concluding trial, after which he promises to proclaim you a master tiger hunter before Master Nesingwary.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now I'm going to up the stakes on you and truly test your skill. Prove to me you can kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers. If you can do that, you will be ready for your final challenge before I declare you a master tiger hunter in Master Nesingwary's presence.
Elder Stranglethorn Tigers are not only the most difficult to find, they are also the fiercest to defeat.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You must kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers before I give you the final challenge that will determine if you are a true tiger hunting master.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Most impressive. I believe you are almost ready.
